note: A throwaway public key from 'adb keygen', shared by every implementation that has to agree about ADB keys. The fingerprint was computed independently with openssl (SPKI DER -> sha256 -> base64, unpadded) so that neither the TypeScript parser nor the Rust one in adb-bridge can define it into being correct. There is no private half here on purpose: the only thing that needs a fixed key is this fingerprint, and that needs the public half alone. Tests that must produce real signatures generate their own keypair at run time rather than keep a private key in the history forever.
